production_graph_findings: True fine IDs are sorted unique actual point-supported IDs; true middle/root IDs are reached by the original two memberships. Allocated padding is excluded without feature-value tests.
Each scene contributes its own complete fine-by-root Cartesian product using distinct global support offsets. Nonancestor edges are included without cross-scene pairing.
One pair_map and original GELU produce q. The same actual q object feeds fine and coarse fixed marginal means, with counts equal to real partner counts.

The third mean consumes actual fine_delta exactly once per unique supported fine, grouped by original middle parent. It is not point-multiplicity-weighted or a mean of coarse groups. One middle_map/GELU consumes normalized original middle and that context.
Only supported original IDs receive private deltas via functional index_copy; unsupported/padded rows stay zero. Empty support/zero batch call no map/GELU/private mean.
Original three LN and raw cf+delta skips feed unchanged HCG readback/message normalization/mask. Original constructor allocates old FFNs/LNs before CPU-fork new maps, then removes all three old FFNs.
